messages:
Sophie: quick capture from this morning's check-in with NorthBay — they had three clear asks and one pain callout
Kevin: share the list pls, i can tag in product backlog
Sophie: pasted raw notes below so we can triage: 
- request: per-team cost breakdown for routes (they want to show to finance)
- request: make `response_format` presets editable in console (they have many custom prompts)
- pain: long tail of failed webhook retries during spikes -> manually resubmit
- idea: embed freshness TTL toggle per-project, not global
Maria: +1 on per-team cost — that impacts renewals directly, finance asked for it in QBR
Diego: webhook retries — do we have telemetry linking failures to backpressure?
Sophie: Diego said they'd share logs; NorthBay had two incidents last month. I asked for timestamps, they sent a CSV snippet: 
```
timestamp,route,status
2026-02-14T16:03:22Z,ingest-alpha,504
2026-02-14T16:03:23Z,ingest-alpha,timeout
2026-02-14T16:03:27Z,ingest-beta,200
```
Kevin: thanks — i can look for correlated queue growth. For product: is per-team cost just a UI filter or requires per-route metering?
Maria: needs accurate attribution for invoices, so per-route metering ideally. UI filter alone won't cut it for finance audits.
ProductBot: FYI — existing metering supports per-route tags but billing export is monthly only.
Diego: could we expose a CSV export with route/tag breakdown as an interim? low-effort win
Sophie: NorthBay would take interim export. they asked for a roadmap ETA, we said we'd follow up after triage
Kevin: propose triage order from CS POV: 1) webhook reliability (renewal risk), 2) per-route metering export (billing), 3) editable presets (DX), 4) embed TTL toggle (nice-to-have)
Maria: agree on that prioritization. add severity notes: webhook = high, export = medium-high, presets = medium, TTL = low
Sophie: action items: 
- Diego: collect logs + link to thread (ETA EOD today)
- Kevin: quick spike analysis and confirm if queue/backpressure is root (ETA tomorrow)
- Maria: escalate billing export ask with AM and capture finance sample formats (ETA 2 days)
- Product: can someone confirm feasibility window for an export endpoint?
ProductBot: product-requests queue created: PR-4521 
Kevin: tagging @Product in case a PM wants to weigh in — the customer is mid-renewal convo next month
Diego: logs uploaded to the shared folder: https://redwood-share/nb-logs/nb-feb14.zip
Sophie: thanks all. i'll compile a short note for the renewal team and include this thread. :thumbsup:
Maria: leaving a short CS summary in the account doc after this, will ping when done.
Kevin: if product wants a quick sync, block 30m tomorrow; i'll coordinate
Sophie: end
